title: Scheduler Production Hardening
description: Thorough audit of core/controlplane/scheduler/ revealed 10 production issues across safety, reliability, observability, and testing. The scheduler is the core job processing engine — it receives jobs via NATS, evaluates safety via gRPC to the safety kernel, dispatches to workers, and manages lifecycle (timeouts, retries, compensation). 4 phases: Critical Bugs, Reliability, Safety Hardening, Observability & Testing.
architectureNotes: Build order: Phase 1 (Tasks 1-2) critical ship immediately, Phase 2 (Tasks 3-5) reliability, Phase 3 (Task 6) safety hardening, Phase 4 (Tasks 7-10) observability parallel. All changes in core/controlplane/scheduler/. Verify with `go test ./core/controlplane/scheduler/... -count=3` after each task. Windows/MSYS: no -race flag.
